en: to pierce, to make a hole; to get through

examples.en: My older sister got her ears pierced yesterday.
I punched another hole in my belt.

examples.ko: 선반을 달려고 벽에 드릴로 구멍을 뚫었어요.
examples.en: I drilled holes in the wall to put up a shelf.
This tunnel was built by cutting through a mountain.
It was hard pushing my way through the crowd.

explain: 뚫다는 구멍을 내거나 막힌 곳을 통하게 한다는 뜻이에요. 구멍이 저절로 생기거나 막힌 곳이 통하면 ‘뚫리다’라고 해요.

phrases.en: braving the rain, through the rain
phrases.nuance_ko: 비, 눈, 추위 같은 어려움을 무릅쓰고 계속 나아간다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: means pressing on despite hardships like rain, snow, or cold
phrases.en_equiv: braving the rain, through the rain

phrases.example: 치열한 경쟁을 뚫고 원하는 회사에 들어갔어요.
phrases.nuance_ko: 많은 사람과 경쟁해서 어렵게 합격하거나 이겼을 때 써요. ‘높은 경쟁률을 뚫다’라고도 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: used after winning or passing a hard competition

explain_en: 뚫다 means to make a hole or to open up something blocked. When the hole forms or the blockage clears by itself, you use the passive 뚫리다.
